aiVerification.summary: Draft cannot be verified because the comparison factor and measurement grouping are misidentified.
issues: Changed factor is filename instead of OK/NG/ST sample condition.
Baseline and changed conditions are not defined.
SPL, THD, impedance, FO, and mask data are mixed under generic metrics.
Header/index/mask numbers appear treated as measurements.
Citations exist but lack enough surrounding rows for reliable grouping.
correctionPlan: Set primary changed factor to sample status groups if confirmed by source rows.
Define ST, OK, and NG roles using sheet headers and context.
Separate outcomes by domain: SPL, THD, impedance, and FO result.
Remove non-measurement header, index, and mask scale values from stats.
Cite header rows plus data/min/max rows for each outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are semantically insufficient for final evidence.
